prevention: Attach contact review to the existing active powerhouse-identity-graph-v1 job without creating another scheduler.
Use bounded four-by-500 batches per existing scheduled execution; preserve older identity-graph work.
Keep provider send authority and suppression checks untouched; review is never proof of outreach.
